# Animal audio

`dog-bark.wav` contains two real dog barks, excerpted from **Dog barking mono** by **Brandon Morris**, submitted by **HaelDB**:

- Source page: https://opengameart.org/content/dog-barking-mono
- Original file: https://opengameart.org/sites/default/files/dog_barking_mono.wav
- License used: [CC0 1.0 Universal](https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/) (one of the source's offered licenses).
- Retrieved: November 3, 2026.

Adaptations: excerpt from 0.48 to 1.49 seconds, gentle 70 Hz high-pass and 7 kHz low-pass filtering, gain ×1.75, 8 ms fade-in and 40 ms fade-out, resampled to mono 24 kHz / 16-bit PCM WAV. The game makes small playback-rate variations between dogs. This asset is served locally and works without an internet connection.

Cat meows remain procedurally generated in `pet-sounds.js`.
